sql: with d as (select date from axis where date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06'), cur as ( select d.date, s.symbol, s.st_flag, row_number() over (partition by d.date, s.symbol order by s.flag_date desc) rn from d left join sth s on s.flag_date <= d.date ), cur_eff as (select date, symbol, st_flag from cur where rn = 1), pnl as (select distinct symbol from bars), bpd as (select date, count(*) n_bars from bars where date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06' group by 1), ev as (select flag_date, count(*) filter (where st_flag) n_true, count(*) filter (where not st_flag) n_false from sth where flag_date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06' group by 1), a_all as (select date, count(*) filter (where st_flag) n_true_all, count(*) filter (where st_flag is null) n_null_all from cur_eff group by 1), a_pnl as (select a.date, count(*) filter (where a.st_flag) n_true_pnl from cur_eff a join pnl using (symbol) group by 1) select d.date, coalesce(p.n_true_pnl, 0) as st_true_count_panel, coalesce(x.n_true_all, 0) as st_true_count_all_symbols, coalesce(x.n_null_all, 0) as st_null_all_symbols, coalesce(b.n_bars, 0) as bar_rows, coalesce(e.n_true, 0) as st_events_true, coalesce(e.n_false, 0) as st_events_false from d left join a_all x using (date) left join a_pnl p using (date) left join bpd b using (date) left join ev e on e.flag_date = d.date order by d.date

select count(*) n_days, count(*) filter (where st_events_true = 0 and st_events_false = 0) n_days_no_event, sum(bar_rows) sum_bar_rows, min(st_true_count_panel) min_st_true_panel, max(st_true_count_panel) max_st_true_panel, (select count(*) from sth where flag_date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06' and st_flag) win_true_events, (select count(*) from sth where flag_date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06' and not st_flag) win_false_events, (select count(*) from sth where flag_date = date '2026-10-20' and not st_flag) bulk_false_on_1020 from (with d as (select date from axis where date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06'), cur as ( select d.date, s.symbol, s.st_flag, row_number() over (partition by d.date, s.symbol order by s.flag_date desc) rn from d left join sth s on s.flag_date <= d.date ), cur_eff as (select date, symbol, st_flag from cur where rn = 1), pnl as (select distinct symbol from bars), bpd as (select date, count(*) n_bars from bars where date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06' group by 1), ev as (select flag_date, count(*) filter (where st_flag) n_true, count(*) filter (where not st_flag) n_false from sth where flag_date between date '2026-10-20' and date '2026-11-06' group by 1), a_all as (select date, count(*) filter (where st_flag) n_true_all, count(*) filter (where st_flag is null) n_null_all from cur_eff group by 1), a_pnl as (select a.date, count(*) filter (where a.st_flag) n_true_pnl from cur_eff a join pnl using (symbol) group by 1) select d.date, coalesce(p.n_true_pnl, 0) as st_true_count_panel, coalesce(x.n_true_all, 0) as st_true_count_all_symbols, coalesce(x.n_null_all, 0) as st_null_all_symbols, coalesce(b.n_bars, 0) as bar_rows, coalesce(e.n_true, 0) as st_events_true, coalesce(e.n_false, 0) as st_events_false from d left join a_all x using (date) left join a_pnl p using (date) left join bpd b using (date) left join ev e on e.flag_date = d.date order by d.date) t
notes: 口径：st_true_count_panel = 面板 60*/00* 内、as-of（flag_date<=当日最后一条）st_flag=True 的家数；st_true_count_all_symbols 是 st_history 全表 as-of 家数（文档 218/20 用此口径）。
st_events_true / st_events_false = st_history 中 flag_date 恰好等于当日的行数，按 st_flag 分列；两者皆 0 表示当日无任何 ST 状态变更事件。
2026-10-20 起 st_true_count_panel 由 218 骤降，因为当日一次性写入 198 行 st_flag=False（见 totals.bulk_false_on_1020）。

sql: with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis), lb as (select symbol, max(date) last_bar from bars group by 1 having max(date) < (select max(date) from axis)), j as (select lb.symbol, lb.last_bar, x.i last_i, (select max(i) from idx) max_i from lb join idx x on x.date = lb.last_bar) select symbol, last_bar, (max_i - last_i) as missing_trading_days, (last_bar > date '2026-10-30') as last_bar_after_eval_end, case when (max_i - last_i) < 5 then '<5' when (max_i - last_i) < 20 then '5-19' when (max_i - last_i) < 60 then '20-59' when (max_i - last_i) < 120 then '60-119' when (max_i - last_i) < 250 then '120-249' else '>=250' end as bucket from j order by last_bar, symbol

with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis), lb as (select symbol, max(date) last_bar from bars group by 1 having max(date) < (select max(date) from axis)), j as (select lb.symbol, lb.last_bar, x.i last_i, (select max(i) from idx) max_i from lb join idx x on x.date = lb.last_bar) select count(*) n_symbols, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols_d, count(*) filter (where max_i - last_i >= 250) n_ge250, count(*) filter (where max_i - last_i < 60) n_lt60, count(*) filter (where last_bar <= date '2026-10-30') n_last_bar_within_eval, count(*) filter (where last_bar > date '2026-10-30') n_last_bar_after_eval, min(last_bar) first_last_bar, max(last_bar) last_last_bar from j
with lb as (select symbol, max(date) last_bar from bars group by 1) select year(last_bar) y, count(*) n_symbols from lb where last_bar < (select max(date) from axis) group by 1 order by 1

with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30'), gi as (select g.symbol, g.date, idx.i from gap g join idx using (date)), r as (select symbol, date, i, i - row_number() over (partition by symbol order by date) grp from gi), runs as (select symbol, grp, count(*) len, min(date) start_date, max(date) end_date from r group by 1,2 having count(*) > 250), later as (select rs.*, (select count(*) from bars b where b.symbol = rs.symbol and b.date > rs.end_date) bars_after from runs rs) select symbol, len as gap_trading_days, start_date, end_date, bars_after, (bars_after > 0) as resumed from later order by len desc
notes: disappeared = 面板内最后有 bar 日早于交易日轴末日（2026-11-06）的标的；missing_trading_days = 该日到最后交易日的交易日数，即此前连续无 bar 的交易日数。

stats.n_last_bar_within_eval = 最后有 bar 日在评估窗内（<=2026-10-30）的只数 = 194；n_last_bar_after_eval = 1 只（最后 bar 2026-11-02，晚于评估窗）= 194+1 = 195。17:27 文档「窗内消失 195 只」按数据末端（2026-11-06）口径，与本次 195 一致；若按评估窗末端 2026-10-30 严格算为 194。
>=250 档不能当退市：resume_after_gt250.segments 里的标的在长缺口后都复牌（bars_after>0），会被误判为已退市。
disappeared_and_resumed_overlap 中的标的（002711.SZ bars_after=30、600891.SH bars_after=30）既在 195 只消失清单里，又有 >250 交易日的中途缺口：它们的复牌只持续 30 根 bar 就再次消失。对这两只，「无行情时长」既不能解释早期缺口（实际是停牌），也无法单独确定末期是否退市 → 末期状态应为 null。
库内无退市日/退市类型字段（instruments 13 列按名匹配 delist/status 为 0），本段只是事后代理，不构成时点正确的退市判定。

sql: with p as ( select i.symbol, i.listing_date as raw_listing_date, try_cast(substr(i.listing_date, 1, 10) as date) as parsed_listing_date from inst i where i.symbol like '60%' or i.symbol like '00%' ), ob as ( select b.symbol, count(*) filter (where b.date <= date '2026-10-30') as observed_bars_at_window_end, min(b.date) as first_bar from bars b group by 1 ), j as ( select p.symbol, p.raw_listing_date, p.parsed_listing_date, ob.first_bar, ob.observed_bars_at_window_end, (select count(*) from axis a where a.date > p.parsed_listing_date and a.date <= date '2026-10-30') as trading_days_listed_to_window_end from p join ob using (symbol) ), pick as ( (select symbol, 1 as grp from j order by parsed_listing_date desc nulls last, symbol limit 5) union all (select symbol, 2 as grp from j where parsed_listing_date < date '2018-01-08' order by parsed_listing_date asc nulls first, symbol limit 5) union all (select '603056.SH' as symbol, 3 as grp) union all (select symbol, 4 as grp from j where observed_bars_at_window_end between 110 and 130 and parsed_listing_date >= date '2018-01-08' order by observed_bars_at_window_end, symbol limit 9) union all (select symbol, 5 as grp from j where parsed_listing_date >= date '2018-01-08' and parsed_listing_date < date '2019-07-01' and symbol <> '603056.SH' order by parsed_listing_date, symbol limit 5) ), pick2 as (select symbol, min(grp) as grp from pick group by 1) select j.*, (j.observed_bars_at_window_end >= 120) as ge_120_observed_bars, (j.trading_days_listed_to_window_end >= 120) as ge_120_calendar_trading_days, (j.parsed_listing_date < date '2018-01-08') as listed_before_panel_start, (j.first_bar > j.parsed_listing_date) as first_bar_lags_listing, case pick2.grp when 1 then 'newest_listing' when 2 then 'oldest_pre_panel' when 3 then 'first_bar_lag_example' when 4 then 'observed_bars_near_120' else 'listed_between_panel_and_eval' end as sample_class from j join pick2 using (symbol) order by pick2.grp, j.parsed_listing_date desc nulls last, j.symbol

select count(*) n_inst_rows, count(listing_date) n_listing_nonnull, count(*) filter (where try_cast(substr(listing_date,1,10) as date) is null) n_parse_fail, min(listing_date) raw_min, max(listing_date) raw_max from inst

with allbar as (select distinct symbol from read_parquet('D:\TSP\data\kline_daily\date=*\*.parquet')) select (select count(*) from allbar where symbol like '%.BJ') n_bj_with_bars, (select count(*) from inst where symbol like '%.BJ') n_bj_instruments_rows, (select count(distinct symbol) from bars) n_panel_symbols, (select count(*) from (select distinct b.symbol from bars b left join inst i using (symbol) where i.listing_date is null)) n_panel_no_listing_date

with j as ( select b.symbol, b.date, count(*) over (partition by b.symbol order by b.date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) ob from bars b ) select count(*) n_symbol_days, count(*) filter (where ob >= 120) n_ge120, round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where ob >= 120) / count(*), 3) pct_ge120 from j where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30'
notes: listing_date 在维表里是 VARCHAR('YYYY-MM-DD')，必须先解析；解析失败行数见 parse_coverage.n_parse_fail。

sample_rows 按五类分层抽样共 20 行无重复：newest_listing（最近上市 5）/ oldest_pre_panel（上市日早于面板起点 2018-01-08，5）/ first_bar_lag_example（603056.SH，首根晚 651 天）/ observed_bars_near_120（observed_bars 110..130且上市晚于面板起点，4）/ listed_between_panel_and_eval（上市在 2018-01-08..2019-07-01 之间，5）。
listed_before_panel_start=true 的标的，库内 bar 被面板起点 2018-01-08 截断，observed_bars 会系统偏小；首根 bar 不等于上市日。
.BJ（北交所）标的：bj_and_missing.n_bj_with_bars 有 K 线，但 n_bj_instruments_rows=0，维表无行 → 无 listing_date，无法算上市天数；它们不在 60/00 面板内。

sql: select count(*) n_missing_symbol_days, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols, (select count(*) from bars where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30') n_rows_eval, (select count(*) from gap) n_gap from gap

with yb as (select year(date) y, count(*) n_rows from bars group by 1), yg as (select year(date) y, count(*) n_missing, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols from gap group by 1) select yg.y as year, yg.n_missing, yg.n_symbols, yb.n_rows, round(100.0 * yg.n_missing / yb.n_rows, 3) pct_of_year_rows from yg join yb using (y) order by 1

with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30'), gi as (select g.symbol, g.date, idx.i from gap g join idx using (date)), r as (select symbol, date, i, i - row_number() over (partition by symbol order by date) grp from gi), runs as (select symbol, grp, count(*) len from r group by 1,2) select case when len = 1 then '1' when len <= 5 then '2-5' when len <= 20 then '6-20' when len <= 60 then '21-60' when len <= 120 then '61-120' when len <= 250 then '121-250' else '>250' end as bucket, count(*) n_runs, sum(len) n_symbol_days, max(len) max_len from runs group by 1 order by min(len)

with d as (select date, count(*) n_bars from bars where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30' group by 1), g as (select date, count(*) n_gap from gap group by 1), ratio as (select d.date, coalesce(g.n_gap, 0) n_gap, d.n_bars, 1.0 * coalesce(g.n_gap, 0) / (d.n_bars + coalesce(g.n_gap, 0)) miss_ratio from d left join g using (date)), hole as (select date from ratio where miss_ratio > 0.01) select (select count(*) from hole) n_hole_dates, (select count(*) from gap g join hole h using (date)) n_gap_on_hole, round(100.0 * (select count(*) from gap g join hole h using (date)) / (select count(*) from gap), 1) pct_gap_on_hole, (select max(miss_ratio) from ratio) max_daily_miss_ratio, (select count(*) from gap g anti join hole h using (date)) n_gap_attributable_to_suspension

with d as (select date, count(*) n_bars from bars where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30' group by 1), g as (select date, count(*) n_gap from gap group by 1), ratio as (select d.date, coalesce(g.n_gap, 0) n_gap, d.n_bars, 1.0 * coalesce(g.n_gap, 0) / (d.n_bars + coalesce(g.n_gap, 0)) miss_ratio from d left join g using (date)) select date, n_bars, n_gap, round(miss_ratio, 5) miss_ratio from ratio where miss_ratio > 0.01 order by date

select count(*) n_rows, count(*) filter (where volume = 0) n_volume_zero, count(*) filter (where amount = 0) n_amount_zero, count(*) filter (where volume is null) n_volume_null from bars where date between date '2019-07-01' and date '2026-10-30'
notes: 停牌口径 = 当日无 bar 行（symbol 存续区间内的交易日缺行）。volume=0 在全库 0 行，不能用 volume=0 判停牌。
采集洞判据：当日 缺行数/(有行+缺行) > 1%。落在这些日期上的缺行属采集缺陷，归因层应给 null，不能算「停牌第 N 日」。
hole_summary.n_gap_attributable_to_suspension = 13,881 - 1,113 = 12,768 格，这是「可能属停牌或退市」的格数上限（仍含长停/退市不可分辨部分）。
gap_runs 给出缺口长度分布；121-250 档 5 段与 >250 档 4 段不可与退市区分，B2 不得据其判退市。
